# WIMU v0.5.0

## What's new

- Optional sound alerts are off by default and can be toggled with the header bell. A notification plays when a usage window resets, and a separate low-battery alert plays when remaining usage crosses its configured threshold.
- The tray indicators continue updating while the panel is minimized. Decorative meter animations pause and the hidden panel skips visual repaints to reduce background rendering work.
- The panel restores its last screen position on launch. A first launch opens centered, and a saved position that is no longer visible falls back to the center.
- The Settings control now uses a gear icon.
